Interface RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIGateway
public interface RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface extends Remote
The RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface interface defines the methods for interacting with the gateway for barrels in a distributed system using RMI. This interface extends the Remote interface to enable remote method invocation.
